title: Gerald Kelsoe Contracting vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing Gerald Kelsoe Contracting and Precision Paint Experts in Lake City or Fort White? What to ask about service area, scheduling, and crews.
h1: Gerald Kelsoe Contracting vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Homeowners in Columbia County often wonder whether a painter will really make the drive. This guide covers the questions to ask about coverage and scheduling.

questions: Do Gainesville-area painters serve Lake City and Fort White?
What should I ask a painter about travel and scheduling?

sections.h2: Hiring a painter outside the big markets
body: Gerald Kelsoe Contracting is a name that can turn up on a Columbia County homeowner's shortlist when it's time to line up painting bids. If your home is in Lake City, in Fort White, or on acreage outside either, there's an extra layer of questions to work through. A contractor may list your town but schedule it only when a crew happens to be nearby, or quote it without seeing the property. Clarifying coverage up front saves weeks of waiting later.
We don't attempt to map out where any other business works. Instead, this guide lists the questions every bidder should answer and shows exactly how Precision Paint Experts handles Columbia County.

Distance should not change the quality of the paperwork. A homeowner on a county road deserves the same itemized scope, named products, and written schedule as someone a few blocks from the shop. If a bid for your property is thinner than you would expect in town, press for the missing details before you sign.

sections.h2: Columbia County inside our five-county map
body: From our Newberry base, crews cover Alachua, Marion, Levy, Columbia, and Gilchrist counties. On the Columbia side, both Lake City and Fort White are regular stops. These are not afterthoughts on a list; the same walkthrough, written estimate, and process apply as for a job in Gainesville or Ocala.

bullets: Will someone walk my property in person before quoting?
How soon can a walkthrough be scheduled out here?
Once I approve, how many weeks until the crew shows up?
Will the crew be your own employees each day of the job?
Is the warranty the same for my location as for jobs closer to your base?

sections.h2: What a Columbia County project looks like with us
body: For a Columbia County home, the crew lead's visit usually happens within 48 hours of your call; you won't be meeting a salesperson. That person measures, takes photos of the current paint and wood, and uses a moisture meter where something looks off. Your itemized quote typically follows a business day later, and crews generally begin one to three weeks after you sign. Because our own crews handle everything and nothing is subbed out, the painters on a Fort White farmhouse are the same faces you'd see on a job in town.

Stucco homes can develop cracking that should be addressed before painting, and our Lake City stucco cracks post covers how. Out here, exteriors carry the same written workmanship guarantee of up to 10 years that we give homes near Newberry, layered over the manufacturer's coverage.

You can reach the office weekdays from 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Ask us for a free estimate with no strings attached, then hold it up against the other bids using the checklist above. Ours will show which surfaces are in and out of scope, the prep, the primer and finish products, how many coats, and the timeline, and nothing gets added later without your signature. Trenton, just over in Gilchrist County, gets the same treatment, as do High Springs and Alachua to the south. To see what we do around Lake City specifically, visit our Lake City painting services page.

faqs.q: Do you really serve Fort White?
faqs.a: Yes. Both Fort White and Lake City fall inside the Columbia County piece of the five counties we cover.

faqs.q: Will you quote my rural property without visiting?
faqs.a: No. Before anything is written up, a crew lead comes out to measure your property and photograph its condition.

faqs.q: Are your Lake City jobs subcontracted?
faqs.a: No. Every Lake City job is staffed by Precision Paint Experts painters, never a subcontractor.
